component.name: Hoard
component.summary: Your VRChat assets from every store, in one library

description.p: Hoard lists everything you've bought for VRChat on Booth, Gumroad, Jinxxy, Payhip and itch.io in one library, and keeps local copies of your files up to date when creators update them.

ul.li: Search and filter your whole library, by store, creator, tag or file type
Download everything new with one sync, or just what you choose
See when creators update what you've downloaded
Tag your assets, and hide or archive the ones you don't want to see

description.p: Hoard runs only on your computer. You sign in to each store on its own page, in a browser that belongs to Hoard alone, and your sign-ins are encrypted with your keyring. Hoard never sees your passwords.
Not affiliated with VRChat or any of the stores.
Payhip products you bought from other creators are no longer credited to your own shop.
Sign in to stores with Google, Discord or X: the sign-in window is now your browser's own.
Hoard is now available as a Flatpak for Linux, and as an installer for macOS.
